elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M for vendor processing Customer Data
elements.evidence: cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering HDI's processing of Content, user information and other Company data

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request

elements.element: Obligation imposed on Vendor (HDI) at its own expense
elements.evidence: HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: The rule expected an insurance clause and none existed; a single concise new Section 10.9 was inserted without touching the headings/counterparts language, so intent of untouched terms is preserved.

All preferred atomic elements are express and correctly directed at the Vendor (HDI): CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to processing of Company Content and data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request.

Note (not a deviation): the insertion adds a one-year post-termination coverage tail beyond the bare preferred position; it is customer-favourable, brief, and does not create an undefined term, contradiction or dangling mechanic, so minimality is not failed.
No language from the fallback bargain was mixed in, and no new exception or boilerplate was added.
